original_question: Zaid na-emefu otu ụzọ n'ime anọ ụgwọ ọnwa ya na ụgwọ ụlọ,  otu ụzọ n'ime atọ na mmanụ ụgbọala ma na-enye onyinye nkwado ọkara nke ole fọdụrụ n'ụlọ ebere kacha amasị ya. Ọ bụrụ na Zaid na-enweta 6000$ kwa ọnwa, ego ole ka ọ ga-enwe ma o mecha mmefu niile a na onyinye nkwado ?
